title: Integrative analyses elucidate transcriptional regulatory functions of risk alleles for metabolic liver disease
abstract: Nature Genetics, Published online: 02 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41588-026-02617-8 This study uses massively parallel reporting assays and CRISPR assays to interrogate chromatin accessibility for genetic variants associated with metabolic liver disease, implicating likely causal variants and genes.
